name: Idebenone
summary: Idebenone is a lab-made relative of coenzyme Q10 that acts as an antioxidant and helps the cell’s energy factories (mitochondria) make energy. It has been studied for some neurological conditions, but psychiatric uses are mostly experimental.
description: Idebenone is a short-chain synthetic benzoquinone and a lab-made relative (analog) of coenzyme Q10 (ubiquinone). It acts as an antioxidant and helps carry electrons in the cell's energy factories (the mitochondrial electron transport chain). It has been studied for various neurological conditions, including Alzheimer's disease, Friedreich ataxia (an inherited condition that affects movement and balance), and other mitochondrial disorders, though psychiatric uses are mostly experimental.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Idebenone is a short-chain synthetic benzoquinone and an analog of coenzyme Q10 (ubiquinone). It acts as an antioxidant and electron carrier in the mitochondrial electron transport chain. It has been studied for various neurological conditions, including Alzheimer's disease, Friedreich's ataxia, and other mitochondrial disorders, though psychiatric uses are mostly experimental.
